from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import asyncio
import time

@dataclass
class RateLimiter:
    rate: int
    per: float
    tokens: int = field(init=False)
    last: float = field(default_factory=lambda: time.monotonic())

    def __post_init__(self):
        self.tokens = self.rate

    async def acquire(self):
        while self.tokens <= 0:
            await asyncio.sleep(self.per)
            now = time.monotonic()
            elapsed = now - self.last
            self.tokens += int(elapsed * (self.rate / self.per))
            if self.tokens > self.rate:
                self.tokens = self.rate
            self.last = now
        self.tokens -= 1

async def fetch_data(rate_limiter, data_source):
    async for data in data_source:
        await rate_limiter.acquire()
        print(f"Fetched: {data}")

async def mock_data_source():
    for i in range(5):
        yield i

async def main():
    rate_limiter = RateLimiter(rate=2, per=1)
    await fetch_data(rate_limiter, mock_data_source())

# To run: asyncio.run(main())

import time

class RateLimiter:
    def __init__(self, max_calls, period):
        self.max_calls = max_calls
        self.period = period
        self.calls = []

    async def acquire(self):
        now = time.time()
